a.lede: Governments, hospitals, courts scrambled by global Microsoft outage.
a.title: Microsoft’s global outage may be worse than Amazon's or CrowdStrike's, expert says

b.lede: Countless businesses, schools, hospitals, and governments have found out the hard way what it means to rely on a single company’s systems to get things done. And next time could be even worse.
b.title: The Microsoft Outage Is a Warning for the World
